title: Native shared UI tokens, workbench, keyboard command palette
summary: Source implementation of a session-only accessible M02 desktop GUI, design tokens, gallery, theme/density and command routing. Backend features remain disabled; visual acceptance pending. P02 regression follow-up: closed shortcut allowlist, fail-closed Windows CI stage separation and contrast-safe secondary text tokens (merge and native accessibility still pending). Modal isolation update: inert background, keyboard routing guard, stable focus return to opener or destination. P02-T02.04 addresses hidden focus on keyboard-focusable Workbench tabpanels with a theme-aware outline, adds fail-closed Windows Python a11y contracts and candidate native capture; final visual acceptance remains pending. T02.06/07: accessible gallery pressed/hover/disabled/status examples with independent sample input, responsive 900px-native gallery and bounded split-grid columns; screenshot candidates and native E2E review remain pending. Scopes T02.06/07 now have passing exact-source Windows CI and direct visual inspection of the SHA-bound native action/898px responsive screenshots (artifact 14804053291); full M02/P02 acceptance and release still pending. T02.09/10/11 scoped acceptance: Windows fail-closed native PNG/metadata verifier and 20 dedicated regression tests, 9 independently inspected SHA-bound real Tauri images and accurate eight-option Help/Wiki docs; full manifest and release remain pending.
migration_notes: No native user-storage schema change or migrated data. UI session state only; offline help bundled from curated static source.
